# Data cards

Every source Craton reads, who made it, under what terms, and what to watch out for. Licences and citations travel with the data: each token carries its licence in `provenance.license` and the hash of the raw file it came from.

| Adapter | Source | Tokens | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`earthquakenpp`](earthquakenpp.md) | EarthquakeNPP benchmark datasets | `seismic_catalog` | `LicenseRef-USGS-public-domain` |
| [`fdsn_catalog`](fdsn_catalog.md) | Earthquake catalogues through any FDSN event web service | `seismic_catalog` | `LicenseRef-per-region` |
| [`gcmt`](gcmt.md) | Global Centroid-Moment-Tensor catalogue (one ndk release) | `moment_tensor` | `LicenseRef-GCMT-cite` |
| [`iers_tides`](iers_tides.md) | Solid-Earth body tide (IERS 2010), computed by Craton | `solid_earth_tide` | `CC-BY-4.0` |
| [`ingv_catalog`](ingv_catalog.md) | INGV earthquake catalogue (ISIDe) | `seismic_catalog` | `CC-BY-4.0` |
| [`jma_hypocenter`](jma_hypocenter.md) | JMA Unified Hypocenter Catalogue (the Seismological Bulletin of Japan) | `seismic_catalog` | `CC-BY-4.0` |
| [`ngl_gnss`](ngl_gnss.md) | GNSS daily positions, Nevada Geodetic Laboratory (IGS20) | `gnss_daily` | `LicenseRef-NGL-as-is` |
| [`pressure_grid`](pressure_grid.md) | Reservoir pressure from a history-matched model, on a grid (one CSV) | `reservoir_pressure` | `LicenseRef-per-region` |
| [`seismic_noise_power`](seismic_noise_power.md) | Daily seismic noise power at broadband stations, from FDSN waveforms | `seismic_noise_power` | `CC-BY-4.0` |
| [`uic_workbook`](uic_workbook.md) | Injection well volumes, one regulator workbook a year (form 1012A layout) | `fluid_injection` | `LicenseRef-per-region` |
| [`zenodo_catalog`](zenodo_catalog.md) | Research earthquake catalogues on Zenodo (one CSV per record) | `seismic_catalog` | `LicenseRef-per-region` |
